title: 1996 Topps Gold #42 Jackie Robinson Brooklyn Dodgers Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1996 Topps Jackie Robinson #42 Dodgers trading card. It features the legendary baseball player who broke the color barrier in Major League Baseball. The card is made of card stock and is an original release from Topps. The card is in excellent condition and perfect for any baseball fan or collector. It is a standard size trading card and has a beautiful gold parallel/variety. The card is in English and was manufactured in the United States. The card commemorates Jackie Robinson's historic career and impact on the game of baseball. It is a must-have for any baseball or sports trading card collector.
